message.content:
Audit what Rankora actually ships today. I need a brutally factual inventory — built vs not built — to decide product positioning and pricing. No assumptions, no marketing language.

**Working dir:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`. Stack: Next 16 + Supabase + Edge Functions (Deno). Routes live in `app/` and `src/legacy-pages/`. Hooks in `src/hooks/`. Components in `src/components/`. Edge functions in `supabase/functions/`.

**Deliver in 3 sections, dense bullet style, file:line citations:**

### Section 1 — Confirmed built features (with proof)

For each capability, mark ✓ if you find concrete implementation (file path + function/component name) or ✗ if absent. No "partial" — either the user can do this end-to-end or they can't. Group by category:

**A. AI / Scoring**
- AI resume ranking (deep scoring) — find the rank-resumes edge function, what model, what scoring dims
- AI JD generator (free-text → structured JD)
- AI summary cards per candidate (auto-generated takeaways)
- AI interview questions per candidate (search "interview_questions" in components/edge fns)
- AI authenticity / fraud / AI-generated resume detection (search "authenticity", "ai_detect", "fake")
- AI rejection email drafting (search "rejection", "reject_email")
- Bias-blind mode (search "blind_mode", "anonymize")
- AI-powered candidate search / semantic search (search "embedding", "search candidates")
- AI candidate matching to multiple jobs

**B. ATS core**
- Job creation + JD editing
- Resume upload (file + URL + email ingest)
- Pipeline stages (custom, drag-drop)
- Candidate tags + notes
- Custom application forms with knockout questions
- Auto-acknowledgement emails
- CSV import / export of candidates
- Scorecards / structured evaluation
- Task management

**C. Sourcing & distribution**
- Branded career page (verify: route, theming, custom slug)
- Google Jobs JSON-LD structured data on career page
- Indeed XML feed
- Custom domain for career page
- Job board distribution (LinkedIn auto-post, Naukri, Monster, etc.)
- Chrome extension for sourcing
- LinkedIn profile enrichment
- Passive candidate database (like hireEZ's 800M profiles)

**D. Communication**
- Email outreach (sequences, templates)
- WhatsApp messaging (search "whatsapp", "twilio_whatsapp", "wa_message")
- SMS messaging (search "twilio", "sms_send")
- Interview scheduling (search "interview", "schedule")
- Self-serve booking links (search "booking_token", "book")
- Calendar integrations (Google Calendar, Outlook)
- Video interview / Zoom integration

**E. Collaboration**
- Team invites + roles
- Notes with @mentions (verify @ trigger code)
- Activity feed
- Real-time updates (Supabase channels)
- Comments on candidates
- Approval workflows

**F. Agency-specific**
- Clients / mandates / placements tracking
- Client portal (clients can log in to view their pipeline)
- Commission / revenue tracking
- Invoicing / billing clients
- White-label branding
- Multi-tenant isolation

**G. Integrations & API**
- Public REST API (verify `public-api` edge function endpoints)
- Webhooks (verify webhook_configs table usage + dispatcher code)
- Zapier integration (search "zapier")
- Slack notifications (search "slack")
- Native ATS bridges (Greenhouse, Lever import)

**H. Analytics & reporting**
- Reports page contents — what charts/metrics exist
- Time-to-hire, source attribution, recruiter productivity
- Funnel / drop-off analysis
- Custom dashboards / saved views

**I. Compliance / enterprise**
- GDPR data export per candidate
- SSO (SAML/OIDC)
- Audit logs (already exists — confirm)
- Data retention controls
- IP allow-list

### Section 2 — What's claimed by marketing but NOT built

After section 1, list every feature the comparison sheet at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/` (or general competitor matrix) implies Rankora has, where you found NO implementation. This is the "we're lying on the pricing page" list. Be specific: "WhatsApp messaging — no twilio/whatsapp imports anywhere, no edge function".

### Section 3 — Hidden strengths nobody is marketing

Features built but NOT mentioned in any marketing/billing copy. The "we forgot to brag about this" list. Especially look for: stage automations, sequence enrollment, talent pool segmentation, custom domains, public API endpoints, edge-function batch operations.

**Budget: under 700 lines. No prose paragraphs. Pure factual bullets with file:line evidence. The goal is for me to know exactly what surface area we have to work with for positioning.**

## RANKORA — PRODUCT AUDIT

#### A. AI / SCORING

**AI resume ranking (deep scoring) — ✓ BUILT**
- `supabase/functions/rank-resumes/index.ts` (lines 1–1300+): Full deep-scoring system with OpenAI GPT integration
- Multi-dimensional scoring: Skill Match, Experience, Tools, Education, Must-Haves

- Fallback heuristic when GPT unavailable (keyword + embedding similarity)
- Dynamic weights per job, interview question generation per candidate

**AI JD generator (free-text → structured JD) — ✓ BUILT**
- `supabase/functions/generate-jd/index.ts` (lines 1–150+): Free GPT-4o generation from responsibilities/requirements
- Generates full ATS-optimized JD with About, Responsibilities, Requirements, Nice-to-Haves, Benefits sections

**AI summary cards per candidate (auto-generated takeaways) — ✓ BUILT**
- `src/components/candidate/CandidateSummaryCard.tsx`: Displays strengths, gaps, matched/missing must-haves from scoring

**AI interview questions per candidate (search "interview_questions") — ✓ BUILT**

**AI authenticity / fraud / AI-generated resume detection — ✓ BUILT**
